Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOB 
SNAP HOOK, WITH SAFETY DEVICE ( PTR-R ) 



1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for snap hook with safety device (PTR-R ) used in 
harness or pack cover of paratrooper parachute medium assembly. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 to 6. 
2.1 The deviations shall be as given in individual figures. 

3. Materials 

3.1 Body — Aircraft quality steel conforming to Designation 40Ni6Cr4M03 of IS : 5517-1978 ' Speci- 
fication for steels for hardening and tempering ( first revision ) '. 

3.2 Inner and Outer Spring — Carbon steel conforming to Designation 75C6 or 85C6 of Table 1 of 
IS : 1570 { Part II )-1979 ' Schedules for wrought steels: Part II Carbon steels (unalloyed steels ) 
( first revision ) '. 

3.3 Guard and Ear — Half hard dull finish carbon steel strip conforming to IS: 4030-1973 'Speci- 
fication for cold rolled carbon steel strip for general engineering purposes ( first revision ) ''. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 All the sharp comers and edges shall be properly rounded off. 

4.2 The ear of the snap hook shall be clearly knurled to a pitch of 1*5 mm and depth of 0*4 mm. 
4-3 The components of snap hook shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other surface defects. 

4.4 The guard body shall be properly hardened and finished dull. 

45 y|-,e ears shall be fixed to the guard as to close all openings around edges of joints between the 
two parts by silver soldering. The silver soldering shall be neat and sound. 

4.6 The snap hook shall be coated nickel over chromium conforming to Grade 4 of IS : 1068-1968 
' Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on iron and steel (first revision) \ 

4.7 The snap hook shall be maintained at a temperature of 150 to 200°C for half an hour after 
cadmium plating and prior to chromate passivation to remove hydrogen embrittlement. 

4.8 The body of the snap hook may be cadmium plated conforming to classification No. Cd12 of IS : 
1572-1968 ' Specification for electroplated coatings of cadmium on iron and steel ( first revision ) ' if 
required by the purchaser. 

5. Tests 

5.1 Hardness — The body of the snap hook shall be uniformly hardened and tempered to give a 
hardness of 370 to 430 HV. 

5.2 Performance — The snap shall be suitably spring loaded to ensure that in the normal position the 
snap firmly closes the hook and that it shall not be possible to open the hook without a pressure 
between 2 to 4 kg being applied to the snap. After being compressed fully and then released 
repeatedly ten times, the snap shall regain its original position ( closing position ) without any perma- 
nent set.

6. Marking — All the components shall be marked individually with the manufacturer's name, initials 
or trade-mark and the country of manufacture. 

6.1 The components may also be marked with ISI mark. The details are available with the Indian 
Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — Only one type of snap hook shall be packed in one carton. Each snap hook shall be 
wrapped in tissue paper and then in cartons. The cartons shall then be marked with the name or 
initials of the manufacturers. The snap hook may also be packed as agreed to between the purchaser 
and the supplier.
